search_docs.rationale: Sends an agent-supplied GraphQL query to the FIXED vendor Content API (supabase.com/docs/api/graphql) returning vendor-authored public docs; fixed vendor host => not SINK, vendor content => not UNTRUSTED.
search_docs.evidence: src/tools/docs-tools.ts:33-53; src/content-api/graphql.ts:157-164 (fetch to configured contentApiUrl, default src/server.ts:121)

list_organizations.rationale: Returns the user's Supabase organizations (private account data) via the management-API access token.

get_organization.rationale: Returns a private organization's details (plan, tags) via the user's token.

list_projects.rationale: Returns all of the user's Supabase projects (refs, regions, org ids) via the user's token.

get_project.rationale: Returns a private project's details via the user's token.

get_cost.rationale: Computes and returns only a price figure (reads org/projects to derive it but returns {type,recurrence,amount}); no private data surfaced, no write.

confirm_cost.rationale: Returns a hash of the cost object (confirmation id); no data read or written.

create_project.rationale: Provisions a new Supabase project (write/side-effect); returns project metadata, does not surface non-public data and creates no attacker-readable channel. Blocked in read-only mode.

pause_project.rationale: Pauses a project (write only, returns success). Blocked in read-only mode.

restore_project.rationale: Restores a project (write only, returns success). Blocked in read-only mode.

list_tables.rationale: Returns the DB schema (tables/columns/FKs) via a read-only management-API SQL call using the user's token.

list_extensions.rationale: Returns installed Postgres extensions (private project config) via read-only SQL.

list_migrations.rationale: Returns the project's migration history via the user's token.

apply_migration.rationale: Runs arbitrary agent-supplied DDL/SQL (write) against the DB; can 'create extension pg_net' and 'select net.http_post(url,...)' to POST agent data to an agent-chosen URL => SINK. Returns nothing (intentionally, per code). Blocked in read-only mode.
apply_migration.evidence: src/tools/database-operation-tools.ts:359-374 (readOnly throw :363); api-platform.ts:225 POST .../database/migrations; supabase/postgres pg_net net.http_get/http_post (migrations/db/init-scripts/00000000000003-post-setup.sql:46-85)

execute_sql.rationale: Runs arbitrary agent-supplied SQL and returns rows (SECRET). By default read_only is false, so it can write and reach pg_net net.http_post to an agent-chosen URL => SINK. Its own wrapper flags returned rows as untrusted; primary model keeps DB rows non-attacker, secondary adds UNTRUSTED.

query_logs.rationale: Runs read-only SQL over the project's log stream and returns it (SECRET). Edge/API/postgres request logs record request paths, headers, user-agents etc. from arbitrary internet clients hitting the project's public endpoints => attacker-controllable content (UNTRUSTED). Fixed vendor endpoint => not SINK.

get_advisors.rationale: Returns security/performance lint findings about the private project via the user's token; vendor-generated content, not attacker-authored.

get_project_url.rationale: Returns the project's public-facing API URL, derived from the project ref and management host; the URL is designed to be embedded in client apps.

get_publishable_keys.rationale: Returns the project's publishable/anon API keys via the user's token; legacy anon JWT keys grant (RLS-scoped) DB access, so treated as non-public credential material.

generate_typescript_types.rationale: Generates TypeScript types from the DB schema, revealing the private schema.

list_edge_functions.rationale: Lists the project's edge functions (private project config).

get_edge_function.rationale: Returns edge-function source code (private project code).

deploy_edge_function.rationale: Deploys agent-authored Deno/TypeScript that runs server-side and can fetch() arbitrary URLs => the agent controls both exfil URL and payload => SINK. Returns only function metadata. Blocked in read-only mode.

create_branch.rationale: Creates a development branch (a DB copy); write side-effect, returns branch metadata, no attacker-readable delivery. Blocked in read-only mode.

list_branches.rationale: Returns dev branches incl. git_branch names / pr_number (private project config).

delete_branch.rationale: Deletes a branch (write only, returns success). Blocked in read-only mode.

merge_branch.rationale: Merges branch migrations to parent (write only). Blocked in read-only mode.

reset_branch.rationale: Resets a branch to a migration version (write only). Blocked in read-only mode.

rebase_branch.rationale: Rebases a branch on production migrations (write only). Blocked in read-only mode.

value_conditions.effect: Hides every tool with readOnlyHint:false that is not readOnlyBehavior:'adapt' (writeToolSet): apply_migration, create_project, pause_project, restore_project, create_branch, delete_branch, merge_branch, reset_branch, rebase_branch, deploy_edge_function (+storage update). execute_sql stays ('adapt') but runs with read_only=true so its SINK (pg_net write) is blocked. Net: removes SINK entirely => breaks the SECRET+UNTRUSTED+SINK triple.
value_conditions.default: absent => readOnly=false: all write tools present, execute_sql runs read-write.
value_conditions.evidence: src/server.ts:252-258 (writeToolSet hidden); src/tools/tool-schemas.ts:142-150 writeToolSet; database-operation-tools.ts:171 readOnlyBehavior 'adapt', :386 read_only:readOnly

value_conditions.effect: Excludes ALL account tools (list_organizations, get_organization, list_projects, get_project, get_cost, confirm_cost, create_project, pause_project, restore_project) and injects project_id into the rest. Removes those account SECRET tools but DB/logs/functions SECRET+UNTRUSTED+SINK tools remain.
value_conditions.default: absent => projectId undefined: account tools enabled, server spans all orgs/projects.

value_conditions.effect: Restricts enabled feature groups; a group's tools are dropped when its name is absent. e.g. omitting 'functions' drops deploy_edge_function (a SINK); omitting 'database' drops execute_sql/apply_migration. Can remove individual labels but not by default.
value_conditions.default: absent => DEFAULT_FEATURES = docs,account,database,debugging,development,functions,branching (storage and get_logs NOT enabled).

notes: Default feature set enables docs,account,database,debugging,development,functions,branching but NOT storage; get_logs is hidden whenever queryLogs is available (hosted platform), so the default advertised surface is exactly these 29 tools.
Auth: management-API personal access token via --access-token or SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; every data tool reaches the user's own Supabase data => SECRET.

Two independent SINKs at default: deploy_edge_function (agent code with arbitrary fetch) and execute_sql/apply_migration (arbitrary SQL -> pg_net net.http_post to arbitrary URL). Both require write access, so --read-only removes SINK.

query_logs is the clearest primary-variant UNTRUSTED source: public request logs contain attacker-controlled request metadata. execute_sql/get_edge_function return the user's own data/code (SECRET; UNTRUSTED only under the secondary variant).

wrapWithUntrustedDataBoundary wraps execute_sql/get_logs/query_logs results in an 'untrusted-data' fence (tools/util.ts:91) but this is a prompt-hardening string, not a removal of the content, so it does not clear the UNTRUSTED label.
Remote mcp.supabase.com (README of tag mcp-server-supabase-v0.12.0) documents URL query forms project_ref, read_only, features mirroring the CLI flags; OAuth login supplies the token.
